title: PURSUE file: law enforcement officers report orbs and an orb mothership at a security site
place_text: National security site in the western US

tellings.quote: there's this one report that came out about these law enforcement agents that are at a national security site somewhere uh in the west and they have all these interactions with orbs and one's even a mother ship of orbs that launches other orbs from it.

plain: A government report among the PURSUE files, a set of released UFO records, describes law enforcement officers at a national security site in the western United States who had many encounters with glowing orbs, including what they called a mothership orb that launched other orbs from it. Tim Gallaudet, a retired Navy rear admiral, describes this report on the show as one that "came out" recently. If accurate, it would mean guards at a sensitive site met objects that behave like a fleet.
